caption: The drawing displays a hat with a wide, oval brim and a tall, peaked crown that features two prominent creases running from front to back. The central image, rendered in shades of gray, shows the hat from an angled front view, emphasizing its three-dimensional form and shaded to suggest texture and depth. Surrounding this central illustration are three additional line drawings: the upper left shows a simple profile view labeled "FRONT," the bottom left gives a side view with a horizontal measurement of "20"," and the upper right features a top-down schematic with the width annotated as "23"." The composition is contained within a single rectangular border centered on a tan background, with the artist's signature, "WM. MILLS," in the lower right corner. The entire drawing uses pencil or similar monochromatic medium, creating a detailed and technical depiction on a plain, neutral background.
title: Man's Hat
